h: Remember and Guard Within Shabbos and Priestly Blessing

p: It says in the Ramban on this parshah (Bamidbar 6:24):
"And the meaning of 'May He bless you and guard you,'
according to the way of truth,
is that the blessing is from Above,
and the guarding is that it guard it,
it appears that he does not mean it simply,
that the blessing is from Above;
to what he himself, of blessed memory, wrote
בְּשֵׁם מִדְרָשׁוֹ שֶׁל רַבִּי נְחוּנְיָא בֶּן הַקָּנָה
in the name of the midrash of Rabbi Nechunya ben HaKanah
the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah.
that this is why we say
And this is what we say:
the One God made us hear;
Hashem is One and His Name is One."
הוּא יִחוּד קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וּשְׁכִינְתֵּיהּ
is the union of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah,
and this is "Hashem is One and His Name is One";
and as is written in the holy Zohar
"The Holy One, blessed be He, One Above,
until she is made in the secret of One," etc.,
the secret of 'Hashem is One and His Name is One.'"
is the Holy One, blessed be He,
הוּא יִחוּד קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וּשְׁכִינְתֵּיהּ
there is the union of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah.
And this is the meaning of
"'Remember' and 'Guard' were said in a single utterance" (Shevuos 20b),
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בְּזֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
in the manner of what is written in the holy Zohar
(רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא פִּנְחָס, חֵלֶק ג רל, א)
"He is truth and She is faith."
were said as a command to Yisrael,
אַךְ זָכוֹר הוּא בְּחִינַת מִדַּת אֱמֶת
yet "Remember" is the aspect of the attribute of truth,
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בְּזֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
in the manner of what is written in the holy Zohar
a place that has no forgetting,
And this is as is written in the Midrash
the study of Torah was implanted in their hearts, etc.;
the evil inclination was uprooted from their hearts," etc.
And this is the meaning of
what is written in Rashi's commentary (Bamidbar 6:23):
zachor and shamor with a kamatz
at the giving of the Torah,
Hashem, may He be blessed, said to them
which is "a place that has no forgetting":
for the study of Torah was implanted in their hearts
by Hashem, may He be blessed.
And likewise "Guard" of the second Commandments
through Hashem, may He be blessed.
that is, there is already an evil inclination,
and then he will be guarded by Hashem, may He be blessed.
for the study of Torah was implanted in their hearts
and the evil inclination was uprooted from their hearts.
were said in a single utterance,
שֶׁהוּא יִחוּד קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וּשְׁכִינְתֵּיהּ
which is the union of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah,
after the evil inclination returned to its place,
Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
for then the main thing is the guarding:
since there is already room to forget,
and afterward he is guarded from Above.
וּבֶאֱמֶת נִכְלָל בּוֹ גַּם כֵּן זָכוֹר
And in truth "Remember" is included in it as well,
since they were said in a single utterance.
יָכוֹל לִזְכּוֹת לְמִדַּת אֱמֶת גַּם כֵּן
one can merit the attribute of truth as well.
"Her husband is known in the gates";
and it says in the holy Zohar
"This is the Holy One, blessed be He,
who is known and cleaved to,
according to what one assesses in his heart,
each one as much as he can," etc.
And on Shabbos there must be
one can merit the attribute of "Remember,"
the aspect of the Holy One, blessed be He:
כָּל חַד לְפוּם מַה דִּמְשַׁעֵר בְּלִבֵּיהּ
each one according to what he assesses in his heart,
so is He known in his heart.
And this is what is written in Rashi's commentary
and as the holy Zohar also asks
that it is the infinitive form,
דְּשָׁם גַּם כֵּן אֵינוֹ מוּבָן הַלָּשׁוֹן
for there too the wording is not understood,
since it is a command to Yisrael,
But it is as we said,
that it is the infinitive form:
that is, that the remembering and the hearing,
שְׁנֵיהֶם הוּא עַל יְדֵי הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
both of them, are through Hashem, may He be blessed;
for the essential holiness of Shabbos
"to know that I am Hashem who sanctifies you" (Shemos 31:13)
is a holiness that is fixed and established
from the side of Hashem, may He be blessed;
but the mitzvah is to remember with the mouth,
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה יָבוֹא הַקְּדוּשָּׁה מִלְמַעְלָה
and through this the holiness will come from Above;
And so here in Birkas Kohanim
that it should be said of itself
from Hashem, may He be blessed,
through the saying of the Kohanim,
similar to what is written in the holy Zohar
behold, Koh, which is ready to bless them;
Koh will speak the blessing of My children;
for when you open your mouth,
it will speak the words," etc.
That is, the Shechinah will speak.
it is written "Thus shall you bless":
"Thus shall you bless" — with the Explicit Name
And this is what they expounded
with the intention of the heart,
so that the blessing may be complete in them," etc.;
and then it will be "amor lahem,"
that the blessing will be said
from the mouth of the Shechinah.
And so it writes in the holy Zohar
"'And Your pious ones will bless You'
And this is what the Ramban wrote:
that is, the Holy One, blessed be He;
And this is similar to the exposition of the Sifrei (Naso 40):
"'And guard you' — from the evil inclination;
and He will guard your foot from being caught.'"
And this is like the matter of "Guard,"
that there is already an evil inclination,
that the King of the kings of kings
stands over him and sees his deeds,
and he will be guarded from the evil inclination;
